title: Wylo
introBefore: Stop losing projects in chat. Wylo turns files, timelines, and owners into one client portal — they open a link and see the current version. No signup. No “send it again.” Product:
features: Look sharp from the first screen: contracts, estimates, references, and stages — organized, not scattered across Telegram and email.
Clients stop asking “where’s the file?”: one lasting link, always the latest version, no account and no onboarding.
AI does the boring part: drop a pile of files — get section suggestions and a roadmap draft you confirm.
Nothing leaks early: polish the portal in draft, publish only when you’re ready.
Your brand on the portal: logo, custom address, password — they see you, not someone else’s product.
Live in one evening: free beta, no card — prove it on a real project while others are still zipping archives.
